title: As Many as 1.5 Million Cicadas Can Crawl Out of One Acre

scenes.text: After 17 years underground, a million bugs crawl out at once.
Periodical cicadas spend 13 or 17 years under the soil.
Then in a single spring, up to 1.5 million can emerge from one acre.
Warming soil and the calendar year set them all off together.
They climb out, shed their skins, and fill the forest with noise.
Seventeen years of waiting. Then everyone out at once.

description:
After 17 years underground, a million bugs crawl out at once.
Periodical cicadas spend 13 or 17 years under the soil, then up to 1.5 million can emerge from a single acre in one spring.
Have you ever lived through an emergence?
first_comment: Seventeen years underground for one loud summer. Would you wait that long?
